title: No P-384 ECDH test coverage — only P-256 tested
description: test_soft_derive_ecdh and test_derive_key_soft only exercise P-256 (65-byte public keys, 32-byte shared secret). P-384 (97-byte public keys, 48-byte shared secret) is a supported curve but has no explicit ECDH test. The soft_derive and C_DeriveKey implementations are generic and should handle P-384, but this is unverified. The PIV piv_ecdh function uses the algorithm byte to distinguish P-256 vs P-384; no test exercises the P-384 code path.
